files.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a single fictional desktop application screenshot used as a moving ambient background behind an interactive academic website graph. Wide 16:9 composition, screen contents fill the image edge to edge, no physical laptop, no photography, no collage. The image must already look softly blurred/out of focus in its actual pixels: window shapes, sidebars and rows are recognizable, but text is only illegible grey strokes and nobody's name, address, message or document can be read. Entirely synthetic content. Do not include real names, people, logos, identifiable avatars, actual URLs, email addresses, account information or private data. A realistic ordinary desktop app UI, not a marketing page, not abstract art. Subtle cool gray window chrome and white/light gray workspace, small muted color accents. Keep enough layout contrast that the application is recognizable as a screen after a white website overlay. All blur must be part of the produced image; no sharp inset or unblurred region. Layout: a realistic desktop web browser with muted sage green tab strip, narrow address bar, white search results area on the left and smaller information card on the right; four stacked results with gray line strokes and one tiny abstract diagram thumbnail, muted blue link-like marks. No readable writing. Approximate visual feel of looking at a research search page through frosted glass.
